question: The members of Rajya Sabha are elected for a term of _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**6 years**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **members of the Rajya Sabha** are elected for a term of **6 years**. This is outlined in the **Constitution of India**.
 
• One-third of the members of the Rajya Sabha retire every two years, ensuring a **continuous rotation** of its membership.
 
• Unlike the Lok Sabha, the Rajya Sabha is **not subject to dissolution**. It is a permanent body and continues to exist, with vacancies being filled periodically.
 
• The Rajya Sabha, also referred to as the **Upper House of Parliament**, represents the states and union territories of India.
 
• The **election process for the Rajya Sabha** members is indirect. Members are elected by the elected members of the Legislative Assemblies of the states and union territories through a system of proportional representation by means of the single transferable vote.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Rajya Sabha Composition:**

 
 
• The maximum strength of the Rajya Sabha is **250 members**, out of which **238 are elected** and **12 are nominated** by the President of India.
 
• The nominated members are chosen for their expertise in fields such as **literature, science, art, and social services**.
 
 
 
• **Eligibility Criteria for Rajya Sabha Membership:**
 
 
• A candidate must be at least **30 years old** to contest elections for the Rajya Sabha.
 
• He/she must be an Indian citizen and fulfill other criteria set forth by the **Representation of the People Act, 1951**.
 
 
 
• **Rajya Sabha’s Role:**
 
 
• It acts as the **Council of States** and provides representation to states and union territories.
 
• The Rajya Sabha plays a significant role in **legislative matters**, except for money bills, which can only originate in the Lok Sabha.
 
• It serves as a check on the Lok Sabha and ensures representation of regional interests at the national level.
 
 
 
• **Difference Between Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha:**
 
 
• The **Lok Sabha** (Lower House) is directly elected by the people, whereas the **Rajya Sabha** is indirectly elected by the state legislatures.
 
• The Lok Sabha has a term of **5 years**, while the Rajya Sabha is a **permanent body**.
 
• The Lok Sabha is larger, with a maximum strength of **552 members**, compared to the Rajya Sabha's **250 members**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Proportional Representation System:**

 
 
• The members of the Rajya Sabha are elected through the **proportional representation** system via the **single transferable vote**.
 
• This system ensures that minority groups also get representation in the Rajya Sabha.
 
 
 
• **President’s Role in Rajya Sabha:**
 
 
• The **Vice President of India** serves as the **ex-officio Chairman** of the Rajya Sabha.
 
• The President of India nominates **12 members** to the Rajya Sabha based on their contribution to various fields.
